project.name: Hermes Mobile
project.purpose: Native iOS and Android clients for Hermes gateway sessions and agent workflows.

goal: Deliver production-ready native mobile clients with secure connectivity, session management, streaming chat, model controls, tools, prompts, media, voice, notifications, localization, and adaptive layouts.
summary: Action intent checkpointed: Push the focused review regression tests to the dedicated mobile branch to obtain candidate-specific Android and iOS RED evidence before applying the held production fixes.
done: Added native model and reasoning controls, runtime-scoped catalog resets, iOS demo capability data, and focused Android/iOS regression tests.
Bound model capability rendering to confirmed runtime state and restored graph-output ignore rules.
Added unknown-model capability guarding on Android and type-independent XCTest lookup for the iOS model controls entry.
Verified production config.set can return confirm_required without applying a high-cost model switch.

inProgress.summary: Commit and push the verified native mobile model-controls candidate to the dedicated branch for remote Android and iOS validation.
inProgress.verify: Read back origin/hermes-agent-Mobile-app SHA, then require candidate-specific Mobile and Mobile Android workflow runs with matching headSha and inspect their completed jobs and artifacts.

inProgress.summary: Push the focused review regression tests to the dedicated mobile branch to obtain candidate-specific Android and iOS RED evidence before applying the held production fixes.
inProgress.verify: Read back the dedicated branch SHA and inspect Mobile plus Mobile Android workflow runs for that exact headSha; require failures to originate from the newly required confirmation, refresh, or generation APIs rather than unrelated infrastructure.

next: Add Android and iOS RED tests for confirmation-required model switches, implement explicit confirmation callbacks, then re-run independent review before push.

verification.summary: Static source/resource checks, localization parity, secret scan, diff checks, remote baseline match, and reasoning-contract parity passed; compilation and tests remain deferred to GitHub Actions.
